domain_hint: UAV S-duct inlet CFD for pressure recovery and swirl at low subsonic
ambiguity_notes:
- Turbulence model choice: text states k–ω SST, but later notes final runs used Spalart–Allmaras with differing impacts.
- Mesh/convergence metrics: residual reductions described as three orders in one place and five in another; GCI reported as 0.8% and also 1.6%.
- Boundary conditions: inlet turbulence intensity given as 1% for design-point but 3% for validation cases; outlet mass flow listed as 4.5 kg/s vs 4.3 kg/s.
- Applicability range: stated as 0–10 deg AoA, but also as −2 to 8 deg in planning notes.
- Acceptance thresholds: ±3% recovery cited in opening, while conclusions reference a ±4% band at nominal.
